description: The 16-digit account number (docs/SYNC.md, The account number): reading what a person typed or pasted, formatting as they type, grouping, and drawing digits from random bytes without modulo bias.

cases.name: a number as shown parses to its digits
leading zeros are kept
hyphens are separators
en and em dashes and dots are separators
surrounding line breaks and tabs are ignored
a no-break space between groups is a separator
a thin space between groups is a separator
empty input is refused
fifteen digits are refused
seventeen digits are refused
a letter among the digits is refused
full-width digits are refused
Arabic-Indic digits are refused
only separators are refused
typing one digit shows it alone
five digits regroup by four
a pasted hyphenated number is regrouped
letters are dropped and digits past sixteen are cut
an empty field stays empty
non-ASCII digits are dropped while typing
sixteen digits group in fours
a partial number groups as far as it goes
an empty number groups to nothing
exactly four digits have no space
bytes that map to zero give leading zeros
bytes of 250 and above are thrown away, not folded into low digits
249 is the last byte kept and maps to 9
250 is the first byte rejected
a block mixing kept and rejected bytes keeps the kept ones in order
a second block is drawn only when the first is not enough
